tha-ap37:1.1: Mogharāja.] Atthadassī tu bhagavā sayambhū aparājito / bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷho rathiyaṃ paṭipajjatha. // //
tha-ap37:2.1: Sissehi samparivuto gharamhā abhinikkhamiṃ / nikkhamitvān' ahaṃ tattha addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap37:3.1: Abhivādetvāna sambuddhaṃ sire katvāna añjaliṃ / sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā santhaviṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap37:4.1: Yāvatā rūpino sattā arūpī vā asaññino / sabbe te tava ñaṇamhi anto honti samāhaṭā. // //
tha-ap37:5.1: Sumacchikena jālena udakaṃ yo parikkhipe / ye keci udake pāṇā antojāle bhavanti te. // //
tha-ap37:6.1: Yesañ ca cetanā atthi *rūpi*no ca arūpino / sabbe te tava ñāṇamhi anto honti samāhaṭā. // //
tha-ap37:7.1: Samuddharas' imaṃ lokaṃ andhakārasamākulaṃ / tava dhammaṃ suṇitvāna kaṅkhāsotaṃ taranti te. // //
tha-ap37:8.1: Avijjānivuto loko andhakārena otthaṭo / *tava ñāṇamhi* jotante andhakārā padhaṃsitā. // //
tha-ap37:9.1: Tuvaṃ cakkhu 'si sabbesaṃ mahātamapanūdano / tava dhammaṃ suṇitvāna nibbāyati bahujjano. // //
tha-ap37:10.1: Piṭharaṃ pūrayitvāna madhukhuddaṃ aneḷakaṃ / ubhohatthehi paggayha upanesiṃ mahesi*no.* // //
tha-ap37:11.1: *Paṭigaṇhi* mahāvīro subhakena mahāisi / bhuñjitvā tañ ca sabbaññū vehāsan nabham uggami. // //
tha-ap37:12.1: Antalikkhe ṭhito satthā Atthadassī narāsabho / mama cittaṃ pasādento imā gāthā abhāsathā: // //
tha-ap37:13.1: Yen' idaṃ thavitaṃ ñā*naṃ buddhaseṭṭho ca* thomito / tena cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati. // //
tha-ap37:14.1: Catuddasañ ca khattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati / padesarajjaṭṭhasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati. // //
tha-ap37:15.1: Pañc' eva satakkhattuñ ca cakkavattī bhavissati / padesa*rajjaṃ asaṅkheyaṃ mahiyā* kārayissati. // //
tha-ap37:16.1: Ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū / Gotamassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajissati. // //
tha-ap37:17.1: Gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ atthaṃ ñāṇena vicinissati / Mogharājā ti nāmena hessati *satthu sāvako* // //
tha-ap37:18.1: Tīhi vijjāhi sampanno katakicco anāsavo / Gotamo satthavāhaggo etadagge ṭhapessati. // //
tha-ap37:19.1: Hitvā mānusakaṃ yogaṃ chetvāna bhavabandhanaṃ / sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap37:20.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap37:21.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mogharājā thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
